arguments.text: Let us begin by examining Orin's sketches to establish basic principles for our study of feather behavior under varying elemental conditions. Wren, your insights on simulating updrafts indoors would be invaluable. Remember, our goal extends beyond entertainment to advancing practical knowledge. We should pool our Air, Earth, Fire, and Water resources to support this endeavor.

arguments.subject: Feather Behavior Study Plan
arguments.text: Priya proposes we use Orin's sketches as a visual guide for studying feather behavior in air currents under different elemental conditions. Wren, focus on simulating updrafts indoors. All voices, contribute resources from our elemental currencies toward this communal study.
